name: tvpipe-party
description: tvpipe.party: short join links for tvpipe's party games and the website (a Cloudflare Worker with D1)

scripts.dev: python3 ../../site/build.py && wrangler d1 migrations apply tvpipe-party --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: python3 ../../site/build.py && wrangler d1 migrations apply tvpipe-party --remote --env-file ../../.env && wrangler deploy --env-file ../../.env
